title: arXiv Mathematics — notable papers from the 16 Oct 2026 announcement batch
global_caveat: arXiv has no official trending chart. This inferred ordering highlights notable mathematical claims, not popularity or downloads; citation and independent-attention evidence is sparse for papers announced only days ago, and no proofs were independently verified.

sections.title: A quantitative form of the planar Falconer distance theorem
sections.abstract: The authors give a quantitative planar multiscale argument showing that compact planar sets with Hausdorff dimension above one have distance sets of positive Lebesgue measure.
sections.claimed_result: For every 0 < η < 1, normalized Frostman measures on compact subsets of the unit ball give distance sets of length at least b(η)>0; localization yields a quantitative lower bound for broader Frostman data.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Planar compact sets supporting probability measures with the displayed Frostman growth condition; quantitative corollary assumes diameter D>0 and bound constant A≥1.
sections.unique_caveat: No endpoint p=1/ε, optimality, asymptotic for b(η), or pinned-distance conclusion is established; proof not independently assessed.

sections.title: The Hopf conjecture with T^3-symmetry
sections.abstract: For closed even-dimensional positively curved manifolds admitting an isometric 3-torus action, the authors prove positive Euler characteristic and extend the result to orbifolds.
sections.claimed_result: Under an effective isometric T^3 action, every closed even-dimensional positively curved manifold has χ(M)>0; the authors also give a rational-cohomology classification of fixed-point components and an orbifold analogue.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Closed, even-dimensional, positively sectionally curved spaces with effective isometric T^3 action; classification is stated for oriented manifolds and orbifolds.
sections.unique_caveat: This does not prove the unrestricted Hopf conjecture; the authors leave open whether one product-type cohomology case can occur for a 3-torus action.

sections.title: A counterexample to the generalized Viterbo conjecture on the spectral distance in a disc cotangent bundle
sections.abstract: The authors prove unboundedness of a Lagrangian spectral distance for manifolds satisfying stated topological assumptions, disproving a generalization of Viterbo's boundedness conjecture, and classify surface cases over Z₂.
sections.claimed_result: For a closed connected R-orientable Riemannian manifold with no conjugate points, H¹(M;ℝ)≠0, and Euler characteristic nonzero in R, the spectral distance on the Hamiltonian orbit of the zero section is unbounded.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Closed connected R-orientable manifold; no conjugate points; nonzero real first cohomology; Euler characteristic nonzero in coefficient ring R. The surface classification is over Z₂.
sections.unique_caveat: The counterexample is conditional on these hypotheses and does not settle the conjecture for all closed manifolds or coefficient rings.

sections.title: The rank problem for metric spaces
sections.abstract: The author constructs a complete second-countable metric space with uncountable Scott rank, answering a question attributed to Fokina, Friedman, Kørwien, and Nies and making the known ω₁ upper bound sharp.
sections.claimed_result: Constructs a complete, second-countable metric space with uncountable Scott rank and develops a Baire-category variant for rederiving known descriptive-set-theoretic rank bounds.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Complete second-countable metric spaces; Scott rank and descriptive set theory.
sections.unique_caveat: The result is specialized; arXiv HTML was unavailable, so the detailed construction and proof were not inspected.

sections.title: Counterexamples to the ordinary Fried conjecture near hyperbolic metrics
sections.abstract: The authors give an AI-assisted construction of real-analytic negatively curved metrics arbitrarily close to a hyperbolic metric in dimension three, for which a torsion identity fails along acyclic unitary characters tending to the trivial one.
sections.claimed_result: For a sequence of metrics approaching a closed hyperbolic 3-manifold's metric and acyclic unitary line characters approaching the trivial character, the torsion-normalized modulus of the ordinary Ruelle zeta value at zero tends to zero.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Closed oriented three-manifold, real-analytic negatively curved metrics, and acyclic unitary line characters approaching the trivial character.
sections.unique_caveat: The authors do not determine whether the Ruelle zeta value itself vanishes at the selected metrics; geometric and spectral inputs are not formalized and require expert review.

sections.title: Transference theory for the trilinear restriction estimate and an application to the quadratic NLS in 3D
sections.abstract: The authors develop a transfer of trilinear Schrödinger restriction estimates to a broader resolution space and apply it to a global theory for the three-dimensional quadratic NLS at critical regularity.
sections.claimed_result: The authors state a global theory for the quadratic nonlinear Schrödinger equation in three spatial dimensions in the critical homogeneous Sobolev space Ḣ^(−1/2).
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Quadratic NLS in three spatial dimensions; the abstract identifies Ḣ^(−1/2) but does not specify the exact data class or solution notion.
sections.unique_caveat: Exact well-posedness formulation and data hypotheses require checking in the full paper before comparing with other global NLS results.

sections.title: Integral and higher-genus quantum McKay correspondence in type D
sections.abstract: For the minimal resolution of C²/BD₄ₙ, the authors prove an integral crepant-transformation statement and, via Givental quantization, an all-genus full-descendent version, with an orbifold GW/DT consequence.
sections.claimed_result: Establishes the integral C×-equivariant Crepant Transformation Conjecture and all-genus full-descendent CTC for the minimal resolution of C²/BD₄ₙ, with a degree-zero orbifold GW/DT consequence.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Binary dihedral groups BD₄ₙ, the specified surface resolution, and associated Calabi–Yau 3-orbifold.
sections.unique_caveat: The claims are specialized to type D/binary-dihedral geometry; full technical hypotheses and proof have not been independently assessed.

sections.title: Uniform estimates for elliptic systems with critical Sobolev coefficients
sections.abstract: The author proves uniform W¹,ᵖ estimates for divergence-form elliptic systems with critical Sobolev–Lorentz coefficients under boundedness and integral-ellipticity conditions.
sections.claimed_result: For coefficients in W¹,(n,s), 1≤s<∞, with L∞-bounded spatially symmetric part and integral ellipticity, the W¹,ᵖ estimate constant is controlled by coefficient norms and the ellipticity constant.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Divergence-form elliptic systems with coefficients in critical Sobolev–Lorentz W¹,(n,s), finite s, bounded symmetric part, and integral ellipticity.
sections.unique_caveat: Domain, boundary-condition, and exponent hypotheses are not fully stated in the abstract; consult the theorem before applying the estimate.
